payload.name: Preserve all enumerated advice items during extraction
payload.description: When extracting a memory from a message that gives the same person multiple distinct pieces of advice, criteria, or requirements, ensure every separate item is preserved in the candidate content.
content: During extraction, if one message contains several distinct recommendations for the same subject (e.g., 'make sure X', 'look for Y', 'it's important that Z'), include each distinct item in the candidate content.
If all items do not fit compactly in one preference/event memory, create separate candidates instead of omitting any item.
Treat phrases like 'make sure', 'it's important that', 'look for', 'avoid', 'must', and 'should' as introducing a separate requirement that must survive summarization.
Do not require verbatim copying or exhaustive inclusion of non-essential exposition; apply only to distinct requirements stated for the subject.

solves: Construction extraction sometimes condenses a message listing multiple distinct advice items and drops one, so later Q&A lacks that claim. This applies when a future message states several separate recommendations for the same subject and a memory is written from it: preserve each item. It does not apply to a single cohesive statement, unrelated details, or verbatim copying; do not expand scope unnecessarily.
